Alex Reed: Flat 2, 64 Example Mews, London W12 8QT is also listed for sale. Does that mean this tenancy is not genuine?
Rowan Pike: Mira Vale is marketing both options. Northbank Example Lettings Ltd has authority for both; the owner will stop sale marketing if this tenancy is agreed.
Alex Reed: Can I view it as a prospective tenant rather than a buyer?
Rowan Pike: Yes. Rowan Pike will show you on 15 November 2026 at 16:00 as a tenant. No payment is required before that.

Tenancy agreement
Property: Flat 2, 64 Example Mews, London W12 8QT
Landlord: Mira Vale
Letting representative: Rowan Pike, acting for Northbank Example Lettings Ltd.
Rent: GBP 1300 per calendar month.
Tenancy deposit: GBP 1500.
The tenancy is periodic from 1 December 2026.
The tenant may end the tenancy with two months' written notice.
No administration fee is payable.
The landlord is responsible for structural and heating repairs, except tenant-caused damage.
